name: Measures for Cybersecurity Review
description: Establishes a mandatory pre-clearance security-review regime for critical information infrastructure operators (CIIOs) procuring network products/services that could affect national security, and for network platform operators holding personal data of over 1 million users seeking a listing abroad. Reviews conducted by the Cybersecurity Review Office under CAC, jointly with 12 other departments (NDRC, MIIT, MPS, MSS, MOF, MOFCOM, PBOC, SAMR, and others).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn).
